in_sanskrit.name: सपर्शवंश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The lineage that has been touched or is in contact with the divine. This name is derived from the Sanskrit roots 'Sparsh' meaning touch and 'Vansh' meaning lineage or descent.

in_hindi.name: सपर्शवंश
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम सपर्शवंश से शुरुआती है संस्कृत स्वरूपों ‘सपर्श’ (स्पर्श) और ‘वंश’ (वंश) के साथ संबंधित रहने वाला वंश या वंशिक द्वारा दिव्य से संपर्क हुआ है या जीवन में संपर्क है।

in_marathi.name: Sparshvansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Touch of Eternity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sparshvansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sparsh represents the sensation of touch, while Vansh means lineage or descent. Thus, Sparshvansh symbolizes the connection between the present and the past, and the touch or influence that past generations have on the present.

in_bengali.name: Sparshvansh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Touch of Eternity
in_bengali.long_meaning: Sparshvansh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Sparsh represents the sensation of touch, while Vansh means lineage or descent. Thus, Sparshvansh symbolizes the connection between the present and the past, and the touch or influence that past generations have on the present.
